request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Keep the main subject of the photo whole inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps it whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

ONE LETTER CARD: in a bright adult-education classroom, one single square white card is stuck in the middle of a clean white whiteboard. The card shows exactly one large, bold, black, printed CAPITAL letter I in a plain sans-serif font with short serifs top and bottom so it cannot be read as a lowercase l or the number 1, centered on the card, filling most of it. Only the capital letter I: nothing else is written anywhere, no other letters, lowercase letters, words, numbers, punctuation or marks on the card, the whiteboard or the room. The card is seen straight on, perfectly sharp and fully legible, in the center of the photo; the classroom around the whiteboard (window light, a green plant, the edge of a desk) is softly blurred. No people and no hands. No logos. The card lies flat against the whiteboard surface, fixed by one small piece of clear tape at its top edge, and the whiteboard fills the frame behind the card from edge to edge; the card does not float in the air. The card has no corner marks, dashes, lines or borders: only the one letter.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-11-16; before tax, not an invoice.
